Bill.BriefDescription: Designating the Pacific chorus frog as the state amphibian.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to designating the Pacific chorus frog as the stateamphibian; and adding a new section to chapter 1.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The Pacific chorus frog, Pseudacris regilla, is hereby designatedas the official amphibian of the state of Washington.
